decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a high-quality, reliable portable Bluetooth speaker. I narrowed my choices down to top-tier brands (Sony, JBL, Harman Kardon, B&O) and one well-rated mid-range option (Ortizan). While the B&O and Harman Kardon offer premium sound, the JBL Charge 5 stands out due to its exceptional 4.8-star rating from over 16,000 reviews and its reputation for durability (IP67) and battery life, making it the most versatile and safe investment for general use.
